  "pros": [
    "Easy and quick list creation process",

    "Robust marketing automation with templates for various use cases",

  "cons": [
    "Navigation can be cluttered with many features hidden in a mega-menu",
    "UI elements sometimes load slowly or cause layout shifts",

    "Steep learning curve for new users to master all advanced features",
    "Pricing can become expensive as contact lists grow larger",
    "Some features, like the landing page builder, may feel less intuitive than dedicated tools"
  ],
  "overall_rating": 3.8
}
